title: 공연장 좌석 찾기: 제 자리가 어디예요?
objective: Ask the way to your seat, politely say someone is in your seat, and guess with -는 모양이다.
summary: Two friends ask an usher for directions and find someone in their seats.
setting: Inside a large concert hall a few minutes before a musical starts.

task.title: Guess, choose, and speak
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to fill in the blanks, choose the right forms, and answer in Korean.

words.example: 좌석 번호는 표 오른쪽 위에 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The seat number is at the top right of the ticket.
Our seats are in the very last row.
When the show ends, leave through the nearest door.

words.meaning: usher, staff who show you the way
words.example: 자리를 못 찾으면 안내 직원에게 물어보세요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you can't find your seat, ask an usher.

words.meaning: to have the wrong idea about, to get (something) wrong
words.example: 시작 시간을 잘못 알아서 늦게 왔어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I had the wrong start time, so I came late.
Please be quiet when the lights go off.

dialogue.korean: 실례합니다. 2층 B구역은 어느 쪽으로 가야 돼요?
dialogue.meaning: Excuse me. Which way do we go for Section B on the 2nd floor?

dialogue.korean: 표 좀 보여 주시겠어요? 저쪽 계단으로 올라가셔서 3번 출입구로 들어가시면 돼요.
dialogue.meaning: May I see your tickets? Go up those stairs and enter through Door 3.

dialogue.korean: 계단을 올라와서 3번 출입구로 들어왔어. 어, 우리 자리인 7열 15번, 16번에 다른 분들이 앉아 계시네.
dialogue.meaning: We came up the stairs and went in through Door 3. Oh, other people are sitting in our seats, Row 7, numbers 15 and 16.

dialogue.korean: 저분들이 자리를 잘못 아신 모양이야. 내가 말해 볼게.
dialogue.meaning: They seem to have the wrong seats. I'll talk to them.

dialogue.korean: 저, 죄송한데요. 여기 7열 15번, 16번이 저희 자리인 것 같은데요.
dialogue.meaning: Um, excuse me. I think seats 15 and 16 in Row 7 here are ours.

dialogue.korean: 아, 그래요? 잠깐만요… 정말 저희는 8열이네요. 표를 잘못 본 모양이에요. 죄송해요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, really? Just a moment… You're right, we're in Row 8. It seems we read the ticket wrong. Sorry.

dialogue.korean: 조명이 어두워지는 걸 보니 곧 시작하는 모양이야.
dialogue.meaning: The lights are going down, so it looks like it's about to start.

exercises: Fill in the blank with -는 모양이에요 (verb, happening now): 사람들이 젖은 우산을 들고 들어와요. 밖에 비가 ____. (오다)
Fill in the blank with -(으)ㄴ 모양이에요 (adjective): 친구가 공연 내내 하품을 해요. 친구가 많이 ____. (피곤하다)
Write the Korean word from the word list: ① the line of seats, as in 12____ ② the person who helps you find your seat ③ the door you use to go in and out of the hall
Answer in Korean: Your ticket says C구역 4열 9번, but a man is already sitting in seat 9. Tell him politely.
answers: ① 열 ② 안내 직원 ③ 출입구
죄송한데요, 여기 9번이 제 자리인 것 같은데요. (저, 죄송한데요. 여기 9번이 제 자리인 것 같아요.)
